summary: Adaptin Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the opening of enrollment in a Phase 1 clinical trial for its therapeutic APTN-101 in glioblastoma. This is an operational milestone, not a special situation. The filing includes a press release and company update but involves no transaction, capital event, or strategic change. The registrant is the issuer/filer. No deal terms are applicable. This is a routine current report; no special-situation classification applies.
